crossRefs.note: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them…
Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
“When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is…
Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
They won’t dwell in Yahweh’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant…
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…
Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might…
Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him, and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.
The king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute…
“Woe to the rebellious children”, says Yahweh, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not…
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in…
Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you to go on the way to Assyria…
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for…

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
translations.bsb: So Ephraim has become like a silly, senseless dove— calling out to Egypt, then turning to Assyria.
translations.kjv: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
translations.asv: And Ephraim is like a silly dove, without understanding: they call unto Egypt, they go to Assyria.
